selected_records.title: "Train classical, deploy quantum" requires rethinking generalization

article.body:
ArXiv listing offers no evidence of quantum deployment

An arXiv cs.LG record dated 31 August 2026 is titled “Train classical, deploy quantum” requires rethinking generalization. The record supplies no abstract, findings or supporting evidence. It therefore establishes neither a policy decision nor a tested or operational quantum capability. No affected public body, military service or supplier is identified, and the title alone does not show what was trained, deployed or demonstrated.
